status: canonical event anchor registry for religious foundations
purpose: Provide notable dates that can be merged into the Foundation Timeline, spiral and map. Events are anchored to foundation records and, where available, to deep lineage nodes.

event_kinds.sacred_seed: traditional revelation/origin clock preserved as such
event_kinds.rupture: destruction, conflict or break that changes the operating field
event_kinds.succession_rupture: authority succession crisis that generates later lineages
event_kinds.council_split: council whose reception/non-reception becomes a durable lineage boundary
event_kinds.reform_seed: high-information start marker for a reform trajectory
event_kinds.differentiation: gradual emergence of distinct lineage identity
event_kinds.diffusion_acceleration: event that rapidly multiplies geographic/social reach
event_kinds.school_marker: teacher/death or community marker useful for later school genealogy but not equal to school birth

merge_contract.rule: A merged timeline may show multiple events for one foundation. Foundation births, ruptures, councils, canonization, reforms and diffusion are distinct clocks.
merge_contract.child_rule: creates_or_crystallizes_child_ids tells the renderer when an event should visibly sprout one or more child trajectories.
merge_contract.branch_position: A child branch attaches at the event date when that event is a high-confidence branch marker; otherwise it begins as a fuzzy formation band.
merge_contract.uncertainty: Approximate/range dates remain bands; exact-looking points must not be synthesized from broad historical estimates.
